thread:
morgan: heads up — since ~2300 UTC some users are hitting a post-auth redirect loop after SAML login. only reproducible for accounts coming from Azure AD. app logs show mixed errors: 'InvalidAudience' and occasional 'Decrypt failed: key not found'. anyone seen this?

kai: can you paste the relevant SAML error from the SP logs? also did we change SP entityID or audience recently?

morgan: log snippet: `saml: error InvalidAudience: expected "https://app.redwood.ai/sso" got "https://APP.redwood.ai/sso"`

aya: we pushed an RBAC/attribute-mapping tweak ~2140 UTC to normalize NameID -> persistent instead of email. i also flipped a mapping that lowercases emails for a different customer, but that was gated. could be related — SCIM provisioning showed a couple of 409s earlier: `scim: 409 duplicate externalId: "USER123@EXAMPLE.COM"`

sam-ops: fwiw, infra rotated the KMS alias yesterday (we documented it in infra-deploys). i see a handful of KMS AccessDenied errors around the same time: `crypto: kms:AccessDeniedException for arn:aws:kms:...:alias/redwood-saml` — maybe key policy change prevented the SAML service principal from decrypting assertion keys.

idp-bot: Deploy #deploy-2024.11.07 completed by infra-team at 2024-11-07T21:45:12Z. Changes: kms alias rotation, rbac-attr mapping tweak.

morgan: ok that lines up. so two hypotheses: audience-case mismatch (APP vs app) and KMS denies leading to assertion decrypt fallback which triggers redirect loop. small sample: user A fails decrypt -> SP returns 302 to login -> idp sends assertion -> fails -> loop.

kai: quick mitigation options: 1) revert the RBAC mapping change (aya) 2) restore previous KMS alias policy allowing `svc/saml` role kms:Decrypt 3) add a temporary transform in SCIM sync to lowercase externalId to avoid duplicates. example quick patch: `externalId = externalId.toLowerCase()` in the SCIM normalizer.

aya: i can revert mapping now and roll an immediate deploy (2-3m). will also add the lowercase normalizer to the SCIM worker and run a targeted re-provision for affected tenants.

sean-infra: i can update KMS key policy to re-grant `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/svc-redwood-saml` kms:Decrypt on the key. snippet we applied: `{"Sid":"AllowSamlDecrypt","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/svc-redwood-saml"},"Action":"kms:Decrypt","Resource":"*"}` — restarting the saml workers after policy change clears cached failures.

sam-ops: policy change applied and restarted the saml pods. seeing fewer decrypt errors in the tail now — a small subset of users still in redirect loop (likely due to the duplicate externalId issue).

morgan: thanks. can we agree owner for follow-up vuln triage? while looking at libs we also noticed the saml library on some older images is behind and had a CVE flagged in our image-scan. won't block this rollback but we should treat it as medium priority to patch.

aya: i'll open an incident ticket, link the logs and affected tenant IDs, and add a postmortem checklist. grabbing :white_check_mark: for the revert and SCIM patch.

kai: after aya's revert + SCIM normalizer and the KMS fix, get a canary of 20 users from affected org to verify. also add an automated test for audience case-insensitivity to the SSO test suite.

morgan: agreed. i'll coordinate canary. thanks all — keep updates in this thread and paste incident ticket when open.
